## Summary
Product designer focused on shipped web and mobile products. I design high-trust experiences with strong visual systems, interaction quality, and implementation awareness.
I like seeing ideas all the way through: from research, user flows, wireframes, and interaction design to production UI, implementation, and QA. My practice combines practical UX, clear information architecture, reusable design systems, and strong visual craft. Staying close to the build helps me make decisions that are both considered for users and realistic for engineers.

## Featured Projects
- PGC Website (2025) - A five-week engagement, including a three-week redesign and build, that replaced an outdated, non-responsive golf club site for prospective members, golfers, and event customers. https://aferguson.art/projects/pgc-website
- Verity Protect (2026) - A production iOS call-screening service that helps older adults and caregivers screen unknown callers while keeping trusted contacts connected. https://aferguson.art/projects/verity-protect
- Wayne NJ Real Estate (2026) - A contracted real estate website redesign that replaced a Squarespace site with a custom, CMS-backed website. https://aferguson.art/projects/wayne-nj-real-estate
